title: Arrays, Collections, and Data
subtitle: Transforming data without slow or unreadable code
description: Practice the array and collection patterns used in UI, APIs, and interviews: map/filter/reduce, grouping, deduping, sorting, Map, Set, and immutability.
learningOutcomes: Choose array methods based on intent
Use Map and Set for lookup-heavy work
Avoid mutation bugs in state updates
Write clear data transformations for API responses
